items.question: What offering must be presented to the bull in this ritual context?
premises: Mouth-fragrance and betel together constitute the offering.
The bull is designated as the recipient.
The prescribed ritual action is to offer.
items.inference: Therefore one should offer mouth-fragrance and betel to the bull.
uncertainties: Whether mukha-vāsana refers specifically to mouth-perfume or more generally to facial fragrance is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: One should offer mouth-fragrance and betel to the bull.
